rows.behavior_contract: Ordinary external URL opens must not preserve foreign web-login credential parameters. Only a URL returned through the authenticated first-party account flow and validated against the exact Fabushi service origin may retain its server-issued auth parameters.
rows.state_machine: untrusted URL -> protocol validation -> strip foreign web-auth parameters -> native open; authenticated account service URL -> exact-origin validation -> accepted-auth context -> native open without stripping server-issued parameters.
side_effects: Sanitizes ordinary HTTP/HTTPS external URL opens before native dispatch
Allows the existing Fabushi account owner to preserve server-issued login parameters only after exact-origin validation
failure_cases: Foreign login token survives an ordinary link click
Renderer or MainEdge can self-upgrade an arbitrary URL into accepted-auth context
Accepted account URL crosses origin or embeds userinfo credentials
Nested percent-encoded parameter name bypasses stripping
rows.ui_disposition: No new UI surface. Reuse existing ProductShell/MainEdge and Fabushi account login flow; this is a security-policy responsibility.
